headline: Tesla Semi filmed hauling first Cybercab delivery batch out of Giga Texas — multiple Cybercabs secured on flatbed trailer being transported by a production-spec Semi (82,000 lbs GCW); follows 60 units staged in outbound lot on Apr 30; first documented delivery run confirms Cybercab manufacturing cadence advancing from pilot builds to active distribution; units likely heading to fleet staging and testing sites

Tesla China-made EV sales jump 36% YoY in April to 79,478 units — sixth consecutive monthly gain as recovery accelerates from 2025 lows; figures include GigaShanghai exports to Europe and other markets; Reuters notes FSD approval delays and aggressive Chinese rival launches as potential limits on further momentum; Q2 delivery pace now well above Q2 2025 baseline

WattEV orders 370 Tesla Semi trucks in $100M deal — California's largest-ever single electric truck order; 50 units to be delivered in 2026 with full fleet by end of 2027; 300+ trucks supporting Port of Oakland freight electrification; WattEV CEO said Tesla Semi was chosen based on 'cost, performance, and availability' in a public RFP process — signals accelerating enterprise fleet adoption as Nevada production ramps

Tesla wins S&P Global Mobility 'Overall Loyalty to Make' award for 4th consecutive year — owners returning to Tesla brand at class-leading rates despite Musk political controversy; structural brand loyalty floor confirmed even amid DOGE-related demand headwinds; loyalty data validates that product quality continues to outweigh political backlash

Unsupervised robotaxi fleet grows to 38 vehicles — Austin: 27 (71% of total), Houston: 6, Dallas: 5; net +8 vehicles since May 6 morning count; 38 Cybercabs in test fleet staged and ready; unsupervised rides now 47.8% of Austin trips (last 7 days) vs <30% weeks prior; fleet ramp accelerating ahead of commercial Cybercab launch

Tesla FSD crosses 10 billion cumulative miles — Musk's previously stated threshold for 'safe unsupervised driving'; 3.7B miles driven on city streets; no immediate unsupervised rollout triggered post-milestone; Electrek notes 'no magical milestone' as Austin robotaxi crash rate reported ~4x human urban baseline per NHTSA filings; data bolsters v15 training case but regulatory and reliability hurdles remain
source: Electrek / The Verge / Drive Tesla Canada

headline: Musk settles SEC Twitter disclosure lawsuit for $1.5M — removes long-running SEC overhang on Musk; settlement does not require admission of wrongdoing; legal exposure clears as Q2 2026 operational focus intensifies on Tesla

RDW presents Tesla FSD to EU Technical Committee in Brussels — Nordic regulators (Sweden, Finland, Denmark, Norway) raise concerns over FSD speeding allowance, icy road performance, and driver distraction; Reuters separately reveals Tesla lobbied Sweden aggressively just 4 days after Netherlands approval before documentation was reviewed; no vote taken; next EU vote windows: July and October 2026; EU-wide approval by summer 2026 now 'increasingly uncertain'

Unsupervised robotaxi fleet reaches 33+ vehicles with hundreds parked and ready across TX — Tesla Robotaxi pricing ~$6.15/ride vs Waymo's $13.93; Dallas and Houston below Austin's fleet density but 100s of robotaxi-marked Model Ys staged in both cities; Cybercabs also staged awaiting deployment authorization

April EU sales surge confirms brand recovery acceleration — France +112% YoY, Sweden +111%, Denmark +102%, Ireland +100%, Romania +53%, Belgium +47%, Netherlands +23%, Switzerland +15%; Europe BEV share hit 20.5% of new car registrations in Q1 2026 (vs 13.2% a year ago)
